repasar.pista: Every answer in your reviews counts, right or wrong.

aprender.pista: Elements, kanji, and words from your lessons.

combo.pista: Correct answers in a row, without a single miss.

rango.pista: From 見習い to 剣士, from 剣士 to 侍… every card that climbs counts.

gramatica.pista: A Tae Kim lesson with its exercises.

yunomi.desc: Freshly made green tea. Nyan blows on it before drinking, even when it's already cold.

onigiri.desc: A rice ball wrapped in seaweed. The filling is a mystery until the last bite.

dango.desc: Three colored dumplings on a stick: pink, white, and green, like spring.

zabuton.desc: For sitting on the tatami to study. Nyan always ends up sprawled on it.

uchiwa.desc: The round fan from summer festivals.

chochin.desc: A warm light for late-night study sessions.

ramen.desc: With egg, scallions, and way too much broth for a cat.

cuaderno.desc: A calligraphy grid full of wobbly 私. We all start like that.

fude.desc: Soft bristles and sumi ink. Every stroke counts.

hanko.desc: The red stamp for right answers. Nyan has one with his name on it.

geta.desc: They go clack-clack along the stone path.

furin.desc: Glass that tinkles in the breeze. They say it cools the summer down.

mikan.desc: The winter treat on the table. They peel in one piece.

senbei.desc: Crunchy rice crackers with soy sauce. You can hear them from the next room.

bonsai.desc: A tiny pine with more patience than you and me put together.

daruma.desc: You paint one eye when you set a goal and the other when you reach it.

gato-suerte.desc: Waves its paw to bring good fortune (and easy reviews).

kotatsu.desc: A low table with a blanket and a heater. Whoever gets in never comes out.

sushi-geta.desc: Tuna nigiri on its little wooden board. For celebrating.

kyusu.desc: Side handle, fired clay, and tea that tastes like a quiet afternoon.

kendama.desc: Ball, stick, and patience. Nyan has been trying the moon trick for three years.

orizuru.desc: Fold a thousand and a wish comes true. This is the first one.

radicasete.desc: Eighties city pop and tapes recorded off the radio.

consola.desc: A greenish screen and batteries that die at the best part.

kingyo.desc: A goldfish won at a festival. His name is Kanji.

andon.desc: Washi paper and candlelight: studying turns into a story.

byobu.desc: Gold leaf and cranes in flight behind the tatami.

katanakake.desc: For hanging your sword once you finally earn it.

tocadiscos.desc: Grandma's enka records. It sounds like Sunday.

cuadro-fuji.desc: Waves, boats, and the mountain in the distance. Your goal, hanging on the wall.

kimono.desc: Silk with a seigaiha wave pattern, ready for the festival.

sakura-bonsai.desc: It blooms all year. Nobody knows how.

kitsune-estatua.desc: The shrine's guardian has decided she likes your room.

kakejiku-ryu.desc: An ink dragon that sometimes seems to move when you're not looking.

taiko.desc: It booms every time you level up. Nyan can't reach it, but he tries.

gafas-sol.desc: For reviewing in style under the summer sun.

boina.desc: A calligraphy artist from today on.

mugiwara.desc: Smells like the beach, watermelon, and vacation.

cascos.desc: For listening to the Kaishi audio on loop.

hanakanmuri.desc: Woven from cherry blossoms. Nyan won't take it off, not even to sleep.

kitsune-men.desc: The summer festival mask. Whoever wears it understands the spirits.

yukata.desc: Lilac cotton with morning glory flowers and a yellow obi. For watching the fireworks with cotton candy in each paw.

maekake.desc: From the stall on the corner. It smells like tonkotsu broth and has a stain nobody can explain.

happi.desc: For carrying the mikoshi and shouting “wasshoi!” until your voice gives out.

parka.desc: Mint green, soft, and with ears on the hood. Perfect for reviewing kanji bundled up to the nose.

gakuran.desc: High collar and five gold buttons: the uniform of whoever sits by the window in anime.

sukajan.desc: Yokosuka satin with a tiger hand-embroidered on the back. Nyan swears the tiger winks at him.

aura-hotaru.desc: Summer fireflies that follow him everywhere. He says they're his students.

aura-yuki.desc: A tiny snowfall just for him. Studying in the cold makes you want a kotatsu.

aura-sakura.desc: Cherry petals that never run out. Each one, a word you won't forget.

aura-hoshi.desc: Little colored stars spinning around him. They say they only appear to those who study at night.

kappa.desc: Loves cucumbers and hates vague answers. If you bow, he bows too, and spills the water from his dish.

tanuki.desc: Disguises himself as words you already know to trip you up.

karakasa.desc: An old umbrella with one eye and a tongue. It hops around on one leg.

nekomata.desc: A two-tailed cat. She respects Nyan, but she won't make it easy.

rokurokubi.desc: Her neck stretches whenever you hesitate. Don't hesitate.

tengu.desc: A master swordsman, and very proud. He rewards precision.

kitsune.desc: Illusions and double meanings: every reading could be a trap.

yukionna.desc: She freezes anyone who answers late. Fluency beats the cold.

oni.desc: Strong, loud, and armed with an iron club. Weak against combos.

ryu.desc: Guardian of the summit. Only those who master its words ever get to see it.
